description_en: Verifies the ID of a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance and the ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the instance belongs and checks whether a CIDR block conflict exists between the routes of the instance and the IPv4 CIDR blocks of the associated office network
description_zh: 校验云企业网实例ID与所属阿里云账号ID是否正确，以及实例路由与办公网络IPv4网段是否存在网段冲突
kebab_example: aliyun ecd verify-cen --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cen-id cen-3gwy16dojz1m650000 --cen-owner-id 1026819517150000 --cidr-block 192.168.0.0/16 --verify-code 120000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: VerifyCen

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account to which the CEN instance belongs.

*   If you own the CEN instance, you can skip this parameter.
*   If you do not own the CEN instance, you must specify the ID of the account that owns the CEN instance
parameters.help_zh:
云企业实例所属的阿里云账号ID。

- 如果配置的CenId属于本阿里云账号，该参数无需配置。

- 如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，请填写所属阿里云账号的ID
parameters.name: cen_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The IPv4 CIDR block of the associated office network
parameters.name: cidr_block

parameters.help_en: The verification code. If you do not own the CEN instance, you must call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436847.html operation to obtain a verification code
parameters.help_zh: 验证码。如果配置的CenId属于其他阿里云账号，必须先调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/436847.html获取验证码
parameters.name: verify_code
